title: Faster levelling to the ultimate
problem: Owner: "fix the levelling so that it doesnt take that long to do ulti". Measured over 60 bot matches: the median hero reached level 4 (the ultimate) at 4:11, and 48% never reached it; about 2 ultimates per match.
scope: Lower the XP needed for levels 2-4 from 100/250/450 to 50/110/180
Every living hero gains 1 XP per second on its own, so the ultimate comes in every match even for a hero on quiet duty
Tests for the new rule; re-check balance with npm run balance (1,200 matches); help text and docs
exclusions: Changing what ultimates do, or the once-per-life rule
The new hero controls (DEC-021, waiting for the owner's choice)

acceptance.text: Time to the ultimate: median under 1:45 and at least 95% of heroes at level 4 by 3:00 in bot matches (measured)
acceptance.evidence: Before: median 4:11 to level 4 and 48% never reached it (60 bot matches). After: median 1:28 and 98% by 3:00 over 600 heroes in 100 matches; now a permanent check in npm run soak (median under 1:45, at least 95% by 3:00). About 7.3 ultimates a match, was 2.1.

acceptance.text: The XP trickle and new thresholds are covered by unit tests; determinism holds
acceptance.evidence: tests/rules.test.ts: 1 XP a second for living heroes, none while dead, and the trickle alone reaches level 4 in regulation time; 95/95 tests; determinism tests pass.

acceptance.text: Balance still in the PLAN-005 targets (npm run balance, 1,200 matches)
acceptance.evidence: 1,200-match balance check (four parallel slices): species 47-53%, heroes 40-62% (Buaya lowest, Seri highest), draws 11%, decided before 2:30 0%, average match 5:19. All inside the PLAN-005 targets.

acceptance.text: Verify, soak and phone check pass
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify; npm run soak 3/3 (including the new ultimate-timing check); PHONE CHECK OK.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

acceptance.text: Owner's verdict: does the ultimate come soon enough?

risks: Heroes reach full strength sooner; balance re-checked with 1,200 matches
Respawn times grow with level, so heroes wait a little longer to come back earlier in the match

added: XP trickle: 1 XP a second for every living hero
Soak check: time to the ultimate
changed: Help text on when the ultimate unlocks
fixed: The ultimate came too late, or not at all for about half the heroes

userNotes: Heroes level up faster: the ultimate (level 4) now comes about 1.5 minutes into a match instead of after 4 minutes, and every hero gains a little XP each second.

approval.evidence: fix the levelling so that it doesnt take that long to do ulti
